title: Exclude a historical C5 caller with a common-cut23 bound
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Exclude the literal historical P112 independent-piece caller `2,3,4^2,7^6` at code-intersection dimension at least six. For ONE common set of at most23 live sites, at most THREE projective directions have residual binary support rank at most7, over every characteristic-zero field using the standard E8 Weyl-chamber theorem. The caller needs six independent directions under a common22-site cut. Live root normals each need at least21 deletions, while four distinct normals share at most14 off-sites: four qualifying directions would require at least4*21-3*23=15, contradiction. A two-direction fixture works at22; attainment of three and sharpness of23 are unclaimed.

**Follow-up audit and correction:** [Nick Petalas's PR3295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3295) already conditionally excludes `4,5^3,6^6` through a six-piece concentration theorem. The earlier suggestion to investigate it as the next gap overlooked that public predecessor. The source-bound composition is now **69/69 in PR[3289](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3289)'s fixed named historical inventory**, conditional on its inherited contracts. The last caller exclusion belongs to PR[3295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3295). This is not a global unresolved count or full C5.

[Detailed fresh proof audit](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/33b6be488be1e9e38f2f3f9bcfc4a7db0e8a332d/research/p112-c5-followup-audit/AUDIT.md) finds no objection to the characteristic-zero/common-set/quotient argument and explains PR[3295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3295)'s coefficient-column and concentration proof. A new table/Fourier implementation imports no predecessor executable and reproduces the complete flat and fourfold histograms. This is same-author AI-assisted checking, not independent human/model or proof-kernel acceptance.

## Exact changes and sources

Three commits,20 changed files:

- Scientific theorem: af26d5be8e1f684e96da080160593bd3bd7accd8, ten files under research/p112-common-cut23-caller.
- Separate workflow repair: ce148e5aa2bbdc6f420e8a6cf6935e37d5b54cd2, the existing #3885 TMPDIR initialization repair in one P112 workflow.
- Fresh audit: **33b6be488be1e9e38f2f3f9bcfc4a7db0e8a332d**, nine files under research/p112-c5-followup-audit. The original theorem package, historical68/69 receipt and all predecessor inputs remain byte-identical; the successor audit explicitly corrects the follow-up guidance.

Canonical main20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90 remains unchanged at the publication checkpoint; priority revision6. The audit's pinned base is ce148e5. Relevant predecessor heads: #3163 89419106cd86896c366e853795978f1bc85f9112; #3289 e8570c50f9591c9ca653a527ed9626aaa703c3bc; #3322 131605e644ec2aa78834d8707fe79bb05f44d169; #3405 4c5e080c93c5d6fc3b744c598d9c9e6e0ba9dd19; **#3295 4cff8128f0f9ea1e61515b95ddbb884366e9362c**. All16 PR[3295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3295) file Git blobs match current canonical main. Its ledger status is partially reviewed; archival intake is not scientific approval. Runtime needs no foreign pending Git objects.

## Validation and CI

CPython3.12.3/Linux x86-64, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-common-cut23-caller
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-six-piece-concentration
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-c5-followup-audit
```

All three registered package replays passed this follow-up session. PR[3295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3295)'s primary, separate generating-basis check and ten behavioral groups passed. Its inherited global12/20 and all-A2 joint22/32 premises were authenticated and inspected, not independently reproved or replayed through their complete source chain.

The fresh audit checks43,435 binary seven-spaces,5,212,200 root/space pairs, all8,214,570 fourfold intersections and both full histograms. Character orthogonality replaces the old bit-mask flat count. Four literal primal supports check all43,435 dual spaces (173,740 comparisons); four semantic faults and three actual optimized CLI corruptions are rejected. The direct fourfold census is corroboration, not a fundamentally new method for that bound. The original package retains its separate lattice/RREF/pair-join checks, common22-site positive fixture and separate/common-cut controls.

The exact audit commit passes the18-file published-byte/source-history check and official export integrity check. Both actual audit commands pass from a committed read-only export without Git metadata under -I -O -Werror -B:4.259s and10.343s, all19 exported hashes unchanged. These are single-run timings, not benchmarks. Syntax/JSON/whitespace checks pass. Ruff crashed locally before diagnostics in the original session; no lint pass is claimed.

**Original head ce148e5 passed hosted CI:** [upstream run39200317292](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39200317292), completed2026-10-19 at04:48:12UTC. Both plan and registered replay succeeded; logs contain all three package PASS markers and outcome=completed. This supersedes the earlier pending status. The earlier fork scientific push failed before jobs on the inherited workflow parse issue; no mathematical failure is inferred from it.

**Current audit head33b6be4 also passed hosted CI:** [upstream run39206283413](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39206283413), completed2026-10-19 at05:50:03UTC. Plan and both registered replay jobs succeeded. Logs include the new Fourier audit/control PASS markers and the original theorem package's three PASS markers, each with outcome=completed. The committed-input checks passed. This confirms execution of both registered packages, not independent human/kernel or full-C5 acceptance.

## Task, overlap and next obligations

User-assigned C5 application/proof audit, explicitly changed scope from complex-rank-shape-decoder; task cards record the decision. Latest entry scan covered643 open PR bodies and final scan647, with seven full REST pages plus an empty eighth, including drafts. Repository overlap helper also searched2,487 local records and surfaced PR[3295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3295) plus the later mixed566-cut32 package that explicitly credits it. Browser-loaded latest C5 replies and handoffs were inspected. Discussion coverage remains partial: all-board refresh is unavailable without gh; arbitrary diffs, all closed bodies and unpublished work are nonexhaustive. No novelty certificate.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19030442). No continuing reservation. The broader uniform normal-plane question remains unsettled, but this conditionally complete inventory supplies no gap requiring it. Before another census, bind a different literal TWOSIDE caller, quotient, common-set budget and needed span bound. Independent review of the Weyl/scalar-extension argument and inherited global/A2 premises remains useful.

Full C5/FINITE, all inherited successor scientific suites, selected cold replay, physical/native/restoration/consumer/supplier/all-size admission, upstream manual P112 execution, Lean, Docker and independent human/kernel acceptance remain unrun or unestablished. No new decoder, paid supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change.

Retain #3283's related concentration credit, #3286's counterexample, joaqcoo and the E8/P112 lineage. Chris R / Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0 and predecessor notices preserved.

Door: two-way. Blast radius: two isolated research packages and the separate existing one-file P112 runner-context repair. No selected record or frozen input is changed; maintainer edits remain disabled. No merge or closure is requested by the audit.
